The '''Ugnorgrad Performance Hall''' was the main facility for [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]]-based music, drama, and dance performances. It was located in the city of [[Ugnorgrad/Legends|Ugnorgrad]] on the [[Ugnaught Surface/Legends|Ugnaught Surface]].<ref name="ActionTidings2" />
